name: Sodegaura (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Sodegaura city emblem in white: a broken ring open at the top enclosing a stylised crescent and a small disc, with two short bars.
history: Municipal flag of Sodegaura, a city in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 30 October 1956.

features.role: Sodegaura city emblem — a broken ring open at the top enclosing a stylised crescent and a small disc, with two short bars
